q: What is the most abundant element in the Earth’s crust?
e: Oxygen is the most abundant element in the Earth’s crust.

q: What percentage of the atmosphere is made up of oxygen?
e: Oxygen accounts for 21% of the volume of the atmosphere.

q: Which catalyst is used in the preparation of oxygen from hydrogen peroxide?
e: Manganese(IV) oxide is used as a catalyst to speed up the reaction.

q: What is the physical state of oxygen at room temperature?
e: Oxygen is a colorless gas at room temperature.

q: What happens when a glowing splinter is placed in oxygen?
e: Oxygen supports combustion and rekindles any glowing thing.

q: What is formed when magnesium reacts with oxygen?
e: Magnesium reacts with oxygen to form magnesium oxide.
Rust is hydrated iron(II) oxide formed when iron reacts with oxygen and water.

q: Which of the following is an acidic oxide?
e: Carbon dioxide is an acidic oxide that reacts with basic oxides.

q: What type of oxide is zinc oxide?
e: Zinc oxide is an amphoteric oxide, reacting with both acids and alkalis.
